# Unconference 2026

![KIND unconference 2025 banner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NES-DEW/dew-img/refs/heads/main/kind/KIND_unconference_2026.png)

## Theme: who are we?

The KIND network is a big and diverse group without a single standard professional identify. This year's unconference is about who we are, what we do at work, and who makes the case for us and what we do?

* What's your professional group/personae?
  * "office-spreadsheet person"
  * digital leader
  * data scientist
  * admin person
* "gang aft agley" - how did you get here?
  * what was your career path to your KIND-ish role?
  * what's your SFW-passion project? What are your rabbit-holes?
  * where are your successes?
* Where do we sit? Are we frontline? Back-office? Somewhere in the middle?
* What do we do at work all day?
  * What would your [professional time use dataset look like](https://www.ons.gov.uk/peoplepopulationandcommunity/personalandhouseholdfinances/incomeandwealth/datasets/timeuseintheuk)?
  * "That'll only take five minutes..." - how do you estimate how long tasks will take?
* What do you think you should be doing at work?
  + from collecting and describing to modelling and intelligence
* what are your barriers (infrastructure) and opportunities (digital tranformation)
* who values your work, and how do you find that out?

## Info

+ our annual community day of chat, presentations, and discussion
+ **Thursday 17th December 2026** 09.30-16:30
+ entirely free and flexible: drop in for ten minutes or come for the whole day
+ live on Teams
+ free and open to all - here's the [registration link](https://events.teams.microsoft.com/event/d30c6b97-95cd-47d6-a729-80053cf48872@10efe0bd-a030-4bca-809c-b5e6745e499a)
+ no recordings because everything is a social session, but will disseminate any shareable materials via the network
